articles.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi's ability to offer betting there
articles.snippet: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission has pursued more than a dozen legal actions to protect what its chief sees as its sole power over prediction markets.

articles.title: Robinhood taps Ripple’s $2.5 billion RLUSD stablecoin despite backing rival USDG
articles.snippet: Robinhood helped launch a rival dollar-backed token, USDG, but will also offer Ripple's stablecoin to retail customers later this year.

articles.title: Nasdaq-100 comes onchain as Janus Henderson and Centrifuge launch first licensed fund
articles.snippet: The $500 billion asset manager is launching an issuer-sponsored fund on Stellar, taking a different approach from third-party stock tokens.

articles.title: Ripple gets a final go-ahead to launch its own U.S. national trust bank
articles.snippet: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency has approved Ripple National Trust Bank (RNTB), Ripple's CEO Brad Garlinghouse announced on X.

articles.title: South Korea weighs fourth delay on its crypto gains tax, pushing it to 2029
articles.snippet: Officials are concerned users of domestic exchanges would bear the tax burden because the U.S. won’t share crypto trading data until 2029.
